proof: Weighted matrix-tree theorem gives |K|=tau>=product>2^3374. Complete original dyadic filtration gives v2(|K|)=3374. Since product>=2^9204, |K|/2^3374>=2^5830; this integer is odd and therefore is actually greater than2^5830. Any finite abelian group with such an order has nontrivial odd primary part; its exponent cannot be256.
